name: Balotaszállás (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Balotaszállás: a crowned yellow shield with a red charge, within a wreath of grapevine, above a yellow scroll inscribed BALOTASZÁLLÁS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Balotaszállás arms with crown, wreath and scroll
